# cutdash - On-Demand Barbering Platform

This is a Next.js project for cutdash, an on-demand barbering platform that connects customers with mobile barbers.

## Project Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- React Icons for iconography
- TypeScript for type safety

## Project Structure
The application includes:
- Customer booking flow
- Barber profiles and dashboards
- Admin panel for platform management
- Payment integration
- Rating and review system
- Real-time availability tracking

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions
- Implement responsive design with Tailwind CSS
- Use React Icons for consistent iconography
- Focus on user experience and conversion optimization

## Business Context
cutdash is a marketplace platform that:
- Connects customers with vetted mobile barbers
- Provides flexible location options (home, office, pickup points)
- Offers instant booking with real-time availability
- Implements commission-based revenue model
- Focuses on trust, safety, and quality control
